description: This file defines the TranslationHelper class which manages translation additions and database interactions for language translations within the OrangeHRM HRM system. It includes methods for loading YAML translations, saving translations into the database, and helper functions for database queries and language identifiers.

classes.name: TranslationHelper
classes.description: A helper class responsible for managing language translations, loading them from YAML files, and persisting them into a database within the HRM system.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the database connection.

methods.name: addTranslations
methods.description: Loads translation data from a YAML file based on directory path and language, then saves each translation.

methods.name: saveTranslationRecord
methods.description: Saves a single translation record into the database, creating a new record if it does not exist.

methods.name: getLangStringHelper
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the LangStringHelper instance.

methods.name: getLanguageId
methods.description: Retrieves the database ID for a given language code.

methods.name: createQueryBuilder
methods.description: Creates and returns a new QueryBuilder instance from the database connection.

methods.name: getTranslationRecord
methods.description: Fetches a translation record ID from the database for a given language string ID and language ID.
